title: VLCC Outlook Remains Foggy 002
summary:
VLCC Outlook Remains Foggy
According to Lloyd's List Intelligence vessel movement data, VLCC TonMiles increased by about 4.8% in the first quarter of 2022 compared to 2021 Q4 and by 4.6% compared to the first quarter of last year. The oil market and trade flows during the first quarter were affected by some major events: First of all, by the invasion of Ukraine, which started in February 2022 and second by the resurgence of Covid in China which led to significant lockdowns in a number of major cities. Both of these developments will continue to affect trade flows for at least the coming months.
